completion.instruction_level_translation_note: The 3178-instruction native size is reported as scope only; token-site checkpoints do not claim instruction-by-instruction translation until an explicit dispatcher/source integration checkpoint exists.

probe.command: pinned x86 MSVC compile/link, then WINEDEBUG=-all /tmp/c1_macro_adapter_test.exe

runtime_trace_instrumentation.note: The observer records actual outer-loop fetch, handler-result, finalization, exception, and scheduler-action events when a concrete host supplies a trace object. It does not itself claim native equivalence or close the held adapter/runtime items.

opaque_dispatch_boundary.note: The callback is a deliberate hold until the explicit typed VM dispatcher and scheduler cleanup are integrated; its presence is not counted as interpreter completion.
